scope: QR-2 S4-4 owner capital declaration and S4-5 owner performance API, local cloud engineering only. Both use the existing disabled-by-default QR2_PERFORMANCE_ENABLED flag.
authority: Owner explicitly GO FE-2b and QR-2 S4-4/S4-5; periodic commit/push authorized. OD-S4-1 through OD-S4-10 govern QR-2. No target deployment, installation or activation.
changes: Owner-only PUT uses canonical session, CSRF and sensitive-action checks; full sorted Bot set, 1000 per-currency versions, strictly next UTC midnight and append-only withdrawal. Declaration and createBot share an owner tuple write so stale SERIALIZABLE snapshots retry.

Owner GET admits the entire selected-currency batch in one RR READ ONLY snapshot before detail reads, then submits one worker job under the shared account/owner slot and deadline. Position-only and foreign-journal discovery cannot hide RP/RX.
Strict owner summaries use range fees and verified account endpoints; no partial total, cross-currency sum, owner TWR or MWR. Audit follows response/commit with at most 20 distinct incident keys.

verification.runtime: Node 24.19.0; PostgreSQL 16.15 in disposable local Docker clusters, SCRAM and wrong-password rejection checked; pg_dump and pg_restore 16.15.

unit.note: Two pre-existing TODOs; includes account real-thread pool regression and independent owner route/pool seam tests.

verification.real_owner_worker: Two Bots funded through real Store writers, actual owner reader and worker thread, exact 1000 cash total, zero range fees/flows/PnL, null owner returns, no-account owner row and unchanged ledger digests. Synthetic future reporting clock after a real next-midnight declaration; no database clock or guard changed.
verification.review: Independent architecture review and independent test authoring; root executed tests and mutations serially and owns acceptance. Findings closed: SUPPORT own:write, first-funding metadata and scalar response bounds.

Independent audit test treated TEXT details as parsed JSON; test corrected with JSON.parse.

limits: Feature flag remains off; capital-model schema installed only inside disposable fixture databases.
Row caps do not establish a byte-size or main-process heap bound. Production capacity and boundary provenance remain unmeasured/UNRECORDED.

Independent contention tests invoke actual routes with one shared slot; server wiring inspected statically, not a concurrent real-HTTP wiring race. Timeout lifetime seam uses a recording worker; existing real-thread account timeout/heap tests and real owner successful compute are separate evidence.
No UI for these new APIs, target readback, private acceptance, host/VPS action, Live, guard reset or Best Inputs apply. READY false; N1 held.
FE-2b remains separate work in progress and is excluded from this commit.
